task.name: Branch Protection Bypass Remediation
task.description: Review direct pushes and administrator overrides affecting protected default branches and surface only changes whose merge requirements were bypassed without an already tracked or explicitly accepted exception.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering and remediating unreviewed protected-branch changes while avoiding duplicate attention on bypasses that are already tracked or explicitly accepted.
activationConditions: A protected default branch receives a direct push, force push, or administrator merge override within the evidence window in a covered repository.
Authoritative repository evidence shows the resulting protected-branch change bypassed at least one required merge control such as required review, required status checks, or merge queue enforcement.
requiredEffects: Each novel bypass finding identifies the affected repository branch, the protected change, the bypassed merge control, and the authoritative repository evidence supporting the determination.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: No protected default branch change within scope bypassed a required merge control.
Every supported bypass finding for the covered protected-branch changes is already tracked or explicitly accepted.
successConditions: Supported bypass findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within 14 days of the workflow run.
Protected-branch changes that satisfied all required merge controls create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A documented emergency exception may intentionally allow a protected-branch bypass for one change while still requiring explicit acceptance evidence.
One protected-branch change can bypass more than one required merge control and therefore produce more than one supported finding.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel protected-branch bypass findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 14 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported protected-branch bypass findings it assigns for covered protected-branch changes.
acceptedEvidence: A merged pull request or follow-up repository change that restores the intended protected-branch state, reverts the bypassed change, or reapplies the change through the required protected merge path.
A closed tracking issue, pull request conversation, or repository-linked exception record that explicitly marks the bypass finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-bypass-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported bypass findings / supported novel bypass findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 14 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel bypass finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned bypass finding set or required repository evidence for the covered protected-branch changes cannot be read.
